name: Baserow MCP
description: Search, read, create, update and delete rows in Baserow databases from ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or Windsurf through Baserow's built-in MCP server, with read-only defaults.

skills.name: Table Schemas
skills.description: Discovers databases and tables in a workspace and retrieves table schemas and field definitions.

skills.name: Search Rows
skills.description: Searches, retrieves and paginates through table rows, for example to find overdue projects or matching customers.

skills.name: Manage Rows
skills.description: Creates, updates and deletes rows when granted; deleted rows go to Baserow's trash and can be restored for three days.
